address: Louise Wentstraat 230, Amsterdam-Oost (Weesperzijde / Amstelkade side of the Oosterpark district): 1992 housing complex of grey-brown brick with dark horizontal bands, four-storey street fronts under a stepped upper floor, curved ends and glazed stair-tower columns
notes: Louise Wentstraat 230 (BAG pand 0363100012165821, built 1992, 386 3DBAG wall surfaces, roof max 27.0 m): a large 1990s housing complex on the east side of the city, 130 m long with a stepped upper floor, curved ends and brick towers up to 27 m. Photographed: the 88 m north-west street front (w01-315), the north-east end (w02-45), the south-west end (w03-225), the south-east courtyard fronts (w04-135 to w06-135) and the corner towers (w07-226, w08-45): grey-brown brick with dark horizontal bands at the floors, cream-framed windows in pairs and triples, vertical glazed stair-tower columns in dark frames, flat roofs with railings.

walls[0] = panel 31 (NW, 88 m, eaves 12.8; surface 36): 4 storeys x 18 bays with string courses. walls[1] = panels 8 and 293 (NW, 61 m and 34 m, eaves 15.5 over a 12.8 m base; surfaces 10, 386): the set-back top floor, one ribbon-window storey. walls[2] = panels 21 and 102 (NE end, 42 m and 31 m, eaves 12.8 and 15.5; surfaces 26, 116): 4 storeys x 8 bays with string courses. Simplified: the dark bands are string courses, window groups are evenly spaced wide windows; 18 bays instead of the photographed 20 to stay inside the triangle budget. Not drawn: the glazed stair-tower columns, the curved south end, the courtyard fronts and the 27 m corner towers (3DBAG massing in brick colour, left blank brick).
Everything not listed stays blank brick.
